content: Service Name Bfx_ Set Bits_<Type Mn>u8u8u8 Syntax void Bfx_ Set Bits_<Type Mn>u8u8u8 ( <Type>* Data, uint8 Bit Start Pn, uint8 Bit Ln, uint8 Status ) Service ID [hex] 0x20 to 0x22 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) Bit Start Pn Start bit position Bit Ln Bit field length Status Status value Parameters (inout) Data Pointer to input data Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This function shall set the input data as '1' or '0' as per 'Status' value starting from 'Bit Start Pn' for the length 'Bit Ln'.
